key_idea: Each cut through the ribbon makes one more piece.
steps: The ribbon is one long strip bent into a U.
Count where the red bars cross the ribbon: 2 short bars on the left arm, 1 short bar on the right arm, and the long bar crosses both arms.
1 cut makes 2 pieces, and each new cut adds 1 more piece. 5 cuts make 5 + 1 = 6 pieces.

choice_feedback.A: That is 1 piece for each red bar. The long bar cuts the ribbon twice.
choice_feedback.B: 5 is the number of cuts. The pieces are one more than the cuts.
choice_feedback.D: That is 2 more than the cuts. The pieces are only 1 more than the cuts.
choice_feedback.E: There are only 5 cuts, so there are 6 pieces.
